description: Files that configure a check, a lint rule, a budget, a test rule or an agent hook. After kickoff, an agent edit to one of them needs a person's approval in the session. Agent review flags a PR that makes one weaker as an owner finding, and auto-merge leaves it for the owner. This list itself is in the one-way-door tier of .clutch/risk.yaml. check-guardrail-coverage fails when a file that a check, a lint plugin or a hook reads matches no pattern here. `exempt` lists files that tooling reads but that set no rule. See docs/contributing/harness-engineering.md#guardrail-files.

exempt.AGENTS.md: check-file-size measures the length of each AGENTS.md file, check-structure allows one in a package, and the doc checks read it as a doc. It sets no rule.
exempt.CLAUDE.md: It holds one line that includes AGENTS.md. check-structure allows it in a package. It sets no rule.
exempt.README.md: check-structure allows it in a package, and the doc checks read it as a doc. It sets no rule.
exempt.docs/contributing/documentation.md: check-docs-temporal skips it because it quotes the changelog phrases. It sets no rule.
exempt.tools/recap/classify-primitives.ts: It writes the PR recap block. It enforces no rule.
exempt.tools/recap/upsert-recap-block.ts: It writes the PR recap block. It enforces no rule.
exempt..agents/skills/setup-verification/refere: A journey header follows its format, and check-journeys quotes its path in a fix. It sets no rule.
exempt..clutch/TRACKER.md: The release workflow generates it on main from the issue files with clutch issues --write. A pull request never commits it. It sets no rule.
exempt.CHANGELOG.md: The release workflow writes it from the changesets, and tools/release/changeset.ts reads it to add a section. It sets no rule.
